capabilities.description: Researches a topic and returns a sourced summary.
capabilities.prompt: Research {{topic}} at {{depth}} depth. Return JSON with keys: summary, sources (array of URLs), confidence. Notify ${TEAM_CHANNEL} only if you find something surprising.

capabilities.description: Explains what a file or function does, and what it assumes.
capabilities.prompt: Read {{path}} and explain {{symbol}}. Return JSON with keys: purpose, assumptions (array), risks (array).
